ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated broadcast control can replace routine announcing, but hosts still define live interaction and personality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 24,100 broadcast announcers and radio disc jockeys were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 22,800 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,300 jobs, with approximately 2,300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $45,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Broadcast Announcers And Radio Disc Jockeys, but it will reduce routine roles. Automated control and AI voices replace standard announcing, shifting hosts from reading scripts toward live interaction, distinctive style, and video. People limited to reading scripts face displacement, while those who control a live program and show personality become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Live interaction: people respond effectively.
Distinctive style: people create recognition.
Improvisation: depends on live human judgment.
Emotional connection: people provide companionship.
Guest coordination: people control the rhythm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10, moderate, means this occupation has meaningful AI exposure in broadcasting. Systems accelerate routine announcing, while interaction and personality remain human strengths.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Meaningful exposure does not mean high risk. Reading scripted announcements is being replaced, not live control and personality. People with distinctive styles who interact well become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Practice both voice work and live response. Pure script reading is shrinking in the AI era, so develop a distinctive style early.
Advance from reading scripts to interaction and video, and learn editing and analytics.
Emphasize livestreaming and audience-interaction experience. Stations value both steadiness and energy.
Do not select talent only for voice quality; assess whether they can control a live program and build a style.

ai_s7_trends: Automated broadcast control becomes widespread, reducing script-reading roles.
Video creates opportunities.
People with distinctive personalities are in greater demand.

body: Radio announcers and DJs host news, music, and talk programs, operate broadcast controls, manage transitions and interaction, shape the program's style, and build relationships with listeners.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated broadcast control can replace routine announcing, but hosts still define live interaction and personality.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动播控能替常规播，但直播里的互动与个性，还是主持人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年广播主持人电台唱片唱片骑师在岗约 2.41 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.28 万人，岗位净减约 0.13 万个，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代主持人，但会压缩常规岗。自动播控与 AI 配音替掉标准播报，主持人从「念稿」挪向「现场互动、个性风格、视频化」。被挤掉的是只念稿的人，有控场与个性的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场互动：接得住靠人。
个性风格：辨识度靠人。
即兴发挥：临场靠人。
情感连接：陪伴靠人。
嘉宾调度：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的播音区——常规播报被系统加速，但互动与个性还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「念稿播报」，不是「直播控场与个性」的岗位。有风格、能互动的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练播音也练临场，AI 时代纯念稿在缩，早点练个性。
从「念稿」升级成「做互动 + 视频化」，学剪辑数据。
突出直播与互动经历，电台看重稳和活。
选人别只看声音，看他能不能控场和做风格。

ai_s7_trends: 自动播控普及，念稿岗缩。
视频化带来机会。
有个性的人更抢手。

body: 广播主持人与电台 DJ 主持新闻、音乐与谈话节目，操作播控并串场互动，塑造节目风格并与听众建立连接。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动播控能替常规播，但直播里的互动与个性，还是主持人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A system can schedule a repayment plan automatically, but the counselor still decides which client is near a breaking point, how to negotiate relief, and how to calm the person.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 31,800 Credit counselors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 32,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,100 jobs, with roughly 2,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $50,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Credit counselors, but it will reduce standardized roles. Intelligent repayment planning speeds up routine consultations, shifting counselors from scheduling toward empathetic negotiation, customized plans, and crisis intervention. People who only build schedules face displacement, while strong negotiators become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Empathetic negotiation: people calm clients.
Plan customization: people understand pain points.
Crisis intervention: people respond to emergencies.
Trust building: people develop relationships.
Creditor communication: people manage negotiations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high exposure area of counseling. Systems accelerate standardized planning, while empathy and customization still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Scheduling tasks are being replaced, not the work of resolving debt. Counselors who negotiate well and customize plans become scarcer as productivity rises. Counselors who only build schedules face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with finance or social work. Pure scheduling work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop communication skills early.
Move beyond scheduling into plan negotiation and empathy. Learn financial planning and work toward managing clients independently.
Highlight patience and a foundation in finance, and specify the cases you have supported.
Do not hire on academic background alone. Look for patience and emotional steadiness.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent planning is becoming widespread, reducing standardized roles.
Empathetic customization creates opportunities.
Counselors who negotiate well are in greater demand.

body: Credit counselors assess clients' debt, coordinate repayment planning and creditor negotiations, and use financial and communication skills to help people regain control.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A system can schedule a repayment plan automatically, but the counselor still decides which client is near a breaking point, how to negotiate relief, and how to calm the person.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动排计划，但哪位客户快崩、怎么谈减免、怎么把人安抚住，还是顾问定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信贷咨询顾问在岗约 3.18 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.29 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代信贷顾问，但会压缩标准岗。智能还款规划把常规咨询提速，顾问从「排表」挪向「共情谈判、方案定制、危机介入」。真正被挤掉的是只排表的，会谈判的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 共情谈判：安抚靠人。
方案定制：痛点靠人。
危机介入：紧急靠人。
信任建立：关系靠人。
债权人沟通：博弈靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的咨询区——标准规划被系统加速，但共情与定制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排表」动作，不是「债务解套」的岗位。有谈判力、能定制的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只排表的顾问。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从金融/社工起步，AI 时代纯排表在缩，早点练沟通。
从排表升级成谈方案 + 共情，学财务规划，争取带客户。
突出耐心和财务基础，写清跟过哪些案例。
选人别只看专业，要看有没有耐心和稳。

ai_s7_trends: 智能规划普及，标准岗缩。
共情定制带来机会。
会谈判的顾问更抢手。

body: 信贷咨询顾问评估客户的债务状况，统筹还款规划与债权人协商，运用财务与沟通手段帮人脱困。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动排计划，但哪位客户快崩、怎么谈减免、怎么把人安抚住，还是顾问定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate a nutrition plan down to the gram, but a dietitian's patience and communication determine whether an older patient follows it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 90,900 Dietitians And Nutritionists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 95,900 by 2034. That represents about 5,000 additional jobs and roughly 6,200 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $73,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dietitians And Nutritionists, but it will handle calculations and plan drafts. AI can quickly analyze nutrients, generate menus, review dietary surveys, and assess meals. Clinical judgment, behavior change, and face-to-face guidance remain human strengths.
ai_s2_accel: AI health records integrating chronic-disease and dietary data
Personalized plans adjusting dynamically to health indicators
ai_s2_auto: Automated nutrient calculations and menu generation
Analysis of dietary surveys and intake records
ai_s3_list: Clinical nutrition judgment: the same health indicator can reflect different conditions and people, so plans must be individualized.
Behavior change: knowing what to eat does not ensure action; effective counseling and continued follow-up make the difference.
Face-to-face guidance: translate technical advice into language patients understand and will use.
Interdisciplinary collaboration: effective plans require coordination with physicians, nurses, cooks, and families.
Tracking and adjustment: affordability, preference, and appetite all affect whether a plan works in practice.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Dietitians And Nutritionists in the moderate AI exposure range. Calculations, plan drafting, and surveys form a substantial share of the work and are increasingly automated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. Accurate AI plans still require human execution, communication, and adjustment. Roles limited to distributing menus face pressure, while Dietitians And Nutritionists with clinical and behavior-change experience become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong foundations in biochemistry, clinical science, and statistics during nutrition study, and plan early for registered dietitian certification. Practice communication and behavior change, and seek hospital nutrition-department placements.

Use AI as a calculation and planning assistant, then spend saved time on follow-up and behavior change. Develop expertise in clinical, chronic-disease, maternal, infant, or sports nutrition. Cases and outcome data strengthen a résumé.

Career changers should first meet qualification requirements through registered dietitian or public-nutrition credentials. Medical, fitness, or food-service experience adds value. Résumés should quantify clients served and health-indicator improvements.

Do not hire Dietitians And Nutritionists based only on certificates. Use a realistic case to test plan design, communication, and follow-up. Candidates who track outcome data merit stronger consideration.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic meal plans based on health indicators and preferences

ai_s7_trends: AI handles calculations and draft plans, shifting Dietitians And Nutritionists toward behavior change and implementation. Follow-up becomes a core competitive skill.
Hospitals, school nutrition programs, and corporate health services expand as demand grows for clinical and chronic-disease nutrition.
The field becomes more standardized as registered dietitian systems mature and opportunities shrink for uncredentialed social-media nutrition personalities.

body: Dietitians And Nutritionists apply nutrition science to assess individual or population needs, design therapeutic and healthy eating plans, and deliver education and interventions. They work with people managing chronic disease and other populations to improve health through food.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate a nutrition plan down to the gram, but a dietitian's patience and communication determine whether an older patient follows it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出精确到克的营养方案，但能不能让那位老人真按这个吃下去，靠的是营养师的嘴皮子和耐心。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年膳食与营养师在岗约 9.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.59 万人，净增约 0.50 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.62 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.38 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代膳食与营养师，但会接管算数与开方。营养素计算、食谱生成、膳食调查、菜单分析，这些现在让 AI 做又快又准。剩下的临床判断、行为干预、面对面指导，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 健康档案整合慢病与饮食数据
图像识别估算餐食摄入
个性化方案按指标动态调整
线上营养咨询与随访平台
ai_s2_auto: 营养素计算与食谱自动生成
膳食调查与摄入记录分析
菜单审核与营养素标签生成
随访提醒与效果数据汇总
ai_s3_list: 临床营养判断：同一指标背后是不同的病与不同的人，方案要因人而异。
行为干预：知道怎么吃不等于能做到，劝得动、跟得住才是本事。
面对面指导：把专业翻译成人话，让患者听得懂、愿意做。
跨学科协作：跟医生、护士、厨师、家属的配合是系统活。
方案落地的跟踪与调整：吃不下、吃不惯、吃不起，都是要解决的问题。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的计算、开方、调查比重不小，这些正被 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 把方案算得再准，也需要人去「执行、沟通、调整」。真正被挤压的是「只发食谱不管落地」的岗位，能做行为干预、有临床经验的营养师反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读营养学专业时把生化、临床和统计基础打牢，注册营养师考试尽早规划。AI 时代别只学「算营养素」，多练沟通与行为干预，实习时争取进医院营养科。
把 AI 当算数与开方助手，省下时间做随访和干预。往临床营养、慢病管理、母婴或运动营养等细分深耕，案例和数据就是你的简历。
转行先过资格关：注册营养师/公共营养师证书是敲门砖。有医疗、健身、餐饮背景者加分，简历里多写「干预XX人、指标改善情况」这类可量化成果。
招营养师别只看证书，要看案例落地能力。面试时给个真实病例让候选人出方案并讲怎么跟踪，能筛掉只会背指南的；有数据随访能力的人值得高配。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 营养素计算与数据库查询
按指标与偏好自动出食谱

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管算数与开方，营养师转向行为干预与方案落地，随访能力成为核心竞争力。
医院、校园营养餐与企业健康管理扩编，临床与慢病营养需求增长。
行业规范化：注册营养师制度完善，无认证的「网红营养师」空间收窄。

body: 膳食与营养师运用营养科学知识，评估个体或群体的营养状况，制定治疗膳食与健康饮食方案，开展营养教育与干预，帮助慢病人群和各类人群通过饮食改善健康。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出精确到克的营养方案，但能不能让那位老人真按这个吃下去，靠的是营养师的嘴皮子和耐心。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: ML can run models and alerts automatically, but Financial Risk Specialists still decide which assumptions to change, how to explain extreme scenarios, and how to answer regulators.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Financial Risk Specialists is projected to rise from about 60,500 in 2024 to 64,400 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with roughly 4,800 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $106,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Financial Risk Specialists, but it will accelerate measurement. Machine learning and automated monitoring speed up repetitive modeling. Risk professionals are shifting from running models to model governance, extreme-scenario judgment, regulatory communication, and risk tradeoffs. Routine measurement roles face the most pressure. People who govern models and explain risks become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Model governance: people set assumptions.
Extreme-scenario judgment: people define boundaries.
Regulatory communication: people set interpretations.
Risk tradeoffs: people choose priorities.
Business coordination: people negotiate limits.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for risk work. Systems accelerate measurement and monitoring, while people still govern models and exercise judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces routine measurement and reporting, not model governance. Professionals who govern models and explain risks become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants who only run models face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in finance, mathematics, or statistics, and practice quantitative methods and programming. Routine measurement is shrinking in the AI era, so develop governance skills early.
Move from running models to governing models and answering regulators. Learn ML and governance, and seek responsibility for a risk function.
Highlight modeling and compliance experience. State which risk categories you have handled. Institutions value consistent and rigorous work.
Do not hire based only on coding speed. Look for governance judgment. Professionals who can answer regulators merit strong performance bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: ML and automation raise productivity, reducing measurement roles.
Stricter regulation creates additional demand.
Professionals with model-governance skills are in greater demand.

body: Financial Risk Specialists lead the measurement and management of credit, market, and operational risk. They coordinate models, exposures, and limits, use measurement and monitoring systems, issue risk reports, and track mitigation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: ML can run models and alerts automatically, but Financial Risk Specialists still decide which assumptions to change, how to explain extreme scenarios, and how to answer regulators.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: ML 能自动跑模型和预警，但哪条假设要改、极端怎么解释、监管怎么答，还是风控定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家金融在岗约 6.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.44 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代金融风控专家，但会加速计量。机器学习与自动化监控把重复建模提速，风控从「跑模型」挪向「模型治理、极端判断、监管沟通、风险平衡」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规计量的助理，有治理力能解释的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 模型治理：假设靠人定。
极端判断：边界靠人握。
监管沟通：口径靠人。
风险平衡：取舍靠人。
业务协调：限额靠人扯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的风险区——计量与监控被系统加速，但治理与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规计量与报告」动作，不是「模型治理」的岗位。有治理力、能解释风险的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑模型的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融/数学/统计本科打底，在校多摸计量和编程。AI 时代纯计量在缩，早点练治理。
从「跑模型」升级成「管模型 + 答监管」，学 ML 和治理，争取负责条线。
突出模型和合规经验，写清跟过哪些风险类型。机构看重稳和严。
选人别只看代码快，要看有没有治理脑子。能答监管的主干，值得给高奖金。

ai_s7_trends: ML 与自动化提效，计量缩。
监管趋严带来增量。
有模型治理力的人更抢手。

body: 金融风控专家主导信用、市场与操作风险的量化与管理，统筹模型、敞口与限额，运用计量与监控系统，出具风险报告并跟进风险缓释。
career_ai_description_block.heading: ML 能自动跑模型和预警，但哪条假设要改、极端怎么解释、监管怎么答，还是风控定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can generate health-education copy, but specialists still decide which populations need outreach, how to build trust, and how to organize activities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 71,800 health education specialists in 2024, projected to rise to 75,000 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 3,200 jobs, with roughly 7,900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $63,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace health education specialists, but it will reduce production roles. Content generation accelerates materials, shifting specialists from writing toward needs assessment, trust building, activity organization, and behavior change. People who only produce standard materials face pressure, while empathetic organizers become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Trust building: empathy depends on people.
Needs assessment: people uncover real pain points.
Activity organization: people manage the field.
Behavior change: people provide follow-up.
Resource connection: relationships depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate content production, while trust and organization preserve a central human role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard-material production is replaceable, not the work of changing behavior. Empathetic, capable organizers become scarcer as productivity rises. Specialists limited to writing face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Develop both public-health knowledge and communication. Pure writing roles are shrinking in the AI era, so learn organization early.
Advance from writing materials to leading activities and changing behavior, with knowledge of chronic disease and aging.
Highlight activities and populations you have served, and state your professional background clearly.
Hire for empathy and organizational ability. People who execute effectively justify higher project-based pay.

ai_s7_trends: As content generation spreads, production roles decline.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代私家侦探与调查员，但会压缩「基础查档」的环节。公开数据检索与图像识别把信息搬运提速，侦探从「查资料」转向「经营线人、现场取证、判断真伪、守法律边界」。会取证懂边界的人更值钱，只搬信息的人被挤。

现场取证：分寸靠人。
真伪研判：经验靠人。
边界守持：法律靠人。
突发处置：应变靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——查档被系统加速，但取证与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「搬信息」动作，不是「挖真相」的岗位。会经营会取证的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会查公开库的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 安保/法务类起步多练取证和边界，AI 时代纯查档在缩。
从查档升级成「线人 + 取证」，学法律边界和证据链。
突出资源和案例，写清办过哪些类型的案。
选人别只看会查，要看懂不懂边界、证硬不硬。

ai_s7_trends: 公开检索普及，查档缩。
企业风控带来机会。
会取证懂边界的人更抢手。

body: 私家侦探与调查员接受委托开展背景核查、寻人查址、 surveillance 与证据收集，运用公开检索、跟踪与访谈形成可采信材料，是民商事调查的关键角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 公开检索能找线索，但线人怎么经营、现场怎么取证、边界怎么守，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the optimal collection route, but when a bin is attached to the mechanical arm, the collector and driver still need practiced teamwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 147,900 refuse and recyclable material collectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 149,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,300 jobs, with about 16,900 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $48,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace refuse collectors, but it will change routing and dispatch. Routes once depended on veteran drivers' mental maps; now smart dispatch systems optimize routes and schedule pickups dynamically using fill-level data. AI also assists recycling sorting. Yet machines cannot fully handle pushing bins, loading trucks, and sorting on site. People still know where a bin is tucked away on a street corner and how best to move it.
ai_s2_accel: Fill-level monitoring sensors: automatically notify dispatch when bins are full
AI sorting recognition: image recognition assists with classifying recyclables
Smart collection trucks: robotic arms provide automated lifting and loading assistance
Digital sanitation platforms: task check-ins and exception reporting
ai_s2_auto: Smart collection route planning: automatically optimize routes using fill-level data
Vehicle dispatch systems: automatically schedule tasks, vehicles, and personnel
Recycling data statistics: automatically aggregate collection volumes and sorting data
Electronic weighing and registration: automatically weigh and record recyclables
ai_s3_list: On-site loading: knowing how to position bins and park the truck efficiently comes from accumulated experience.
Sorting judgment and handling: people must oversee mixed waste and identify hazardous materials.
Route knowledge and adaptability: people make last-minute adjustments when roads are closed or waste volumes change.
Safety and hygiene habits: awareness of traffic and falling-object hazards during road work is vital.
Coordination with residents and collection sites: people must handle complaints, illegal dumping, and handoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects that most of this work happens on streets and trucks. AI is optimizing desk-based tasks such as routing and dispatch, but for on-site work such as pushing bins, loading trucks, and sorting, it can only assist through equipment and cannot replace human hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Roles involving only physical labor and no equipment skills face the greatest pressure. Smart collection trucks and route optimization improve efficiency, while workers who can operate equipment and understand sorting are increasingly sought after. In this aging industry, younger workers willing to enter the field are already scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Formal education requirements are low, though vocational training in logistics or machinery is helpful. Focus on driving and sorting knowledge, and earn a commercial driver's license or operating certificate. In the AI era, workers who can operate smart collection trucks and understand sorting are more competitive, with stable jobs and major labor shortages.

Do not rely on physical strength alone. Learn driving, smart dispatch systems, and sorting standards to progress from loader to collection driver or crew leader. A driver's license and operating certificate offer the best return on investment for advancement.

Sanitation companies and recycling businesses have persistent labor shortages, making entry quick. Applicants with driver's licenses receive priority, and driving collection trucks pays more. On your resume, quantify results such as service area, volume handled, and sorting compliance rate.

Do not hire based only on physical strength; prioritize reliability and responsibility. Workers who operate equipment, understand sorting, and tolerate early-morning shifts are scarce. Adequate social insurance and overtime pay can significantly reduce turnover.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Fill-level data, route optimization, automatic task assignment
Robotic-arm lifting and automated loading assistance

ai_s7_trends: Waste sorting and zero-waste city initiatives are expanding recycling systems and increasing jobs in separated collection and recycling sites.
Smart dispatch, fill-level monitoring, and smart collection trucks improve efficiency, shifting demand from pure manual labor toward workers who operate equipment and understand sorting.
The industry is visibly aging and faces a major shortage of younger workers, increasing the bargaining power of skilled people willing to enter it.

body: Refuse and recyclable material collectors perform scheduled collection, loading, transport, and sorting of household waste and recyclables. Their work includes removing waste bins, collecting separated recyclables, and sorting at facilities, making them essential frontline workers in urban sanitation and resource recovery systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the optimal collection route, but when a bin is attached to the mechanical arm, the collector and driver still need practiced teamwork.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最优收运路线，但垃圾桶挂上机械臂那一刻的配合，还得收集员和司机凭默契完成。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年可回收材料收集员在岗约 14.79 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.92 万人，净增约 0.13 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.69 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代垃圾收集员，但会改变「路线和调度」这件事。以前路线靠老司机脑子里的地图，现在有智能调度系统优化收运路线、按满桶数据动态排单；回收分拣也有 AI 辅助识别。可推桶、装车、现场分类这些体力活，机器做不干净——街角那个桶放在哪、怎么顺手，还得人。
ai_s2_accel: 满桶监测传感器：桶满自动上报调度
AI 分类识别：图像识别辅助可回收物分类
智能清运车：机械臂自动举升、装载辅助
环卫数字化平台：任务打卡、异常上报
ai_s2_auto: 智能收运路线规划：按满桶数据自动优化路线
车辆调度系统：任务、车辆、人员自动排班
回收数据统计：收运量与分类数据自动汇总
电子称重与登记：回收物自动称重录入
ai_s3_list: 现场装车作业：桶怎么放、车怎么停顺手，靠的是日积月累的经验。
分类判断与处置：混装怎么处理、危险物怎么识别，要靠人把关。
路线熟悉与应变：小区封路、垃圾量变化，临时调整靠人。
安全与卫生习惯：道路作业防车辆、防砸伤，安全意识是命。
与居民和站点的协调：投诉、乱倒、交接，需要人来沟通。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在街道和车上——路线、调度这些桌面活正被 AI 优化，但推桶、装车、分类这些现场活，AI 只能辅助设备，替不了人的手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。真正被压缩的是「纯体力、不懂设备」的岗位——智能清运车和路线优化让效率提升，会开设备、懂分类的工人反而更抢手。老龄化严重的行业里，愿意入行的年轻人本身就稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，职校物流、机械类专业可加分。想入行重点练驾驶和分类知识，考个 B 照或作业证。AI 时代，会开智能清运车、懂分类的工人更吃香，岗位稳定且缺口大。
别只靠体力。把驾驶、智能调度系统、分类标准学起来，从「装卸工」升级为「清运驾驶员/班组长」。考驾照和作业证是投入产出比最高的升级路径。
环卫公司和回收企业常年缺人，入门快。有驾照优先，能直接开清运车收入更高。简历上写「收运区域、处理量、分类达标率」这类可量化成果。
招人别只看体力，要看稳定性和责任心。能开设备、懂分类、扛得住凌晨作业的工人，是行业稀缺资源，给足社保和加班费能有效降低流失率。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 满桶数据、路线优化、自动派单
机械臂举升、自动装载辅助

ai_s7_trends: 垃圾分类与「无废城市」建设推动回收体系扩张，分类收集与回收站点岗位增加。
智能调度、满桶监测和智能清运车提升收运效率，纯体力岗位需求向「会开设备、懂分类」转型。
行业老龄化明显，年轻劳动力缺口大，愿意入行且有技能的人议价空间在上升。

body: 垃圾与可回收物收集员负责生活垃圾与可回收物的定点收集、装载运输与分类投放，包括桶装垃圾清运、分类回收和站点分拣，是城市环卫与再生资源回收体系的基础执行岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最优收运路线，但垃圾桶挂上机械臂那一刻的配合，还得收集员和司机凭默契完成。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can find the optimal schedule and issue a ticket in one second, but when a flight is canceled, dozens of stranded travelers need more than a link. They need someone who can make decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 131,900 reservation and transportation ticket agents and travel clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 135,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,700 jobs, with approximately 14,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $41,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate the entire occupation, but it will absorb a large share of routine operations. Online check-in, self-service ticketing, and AI customer service have already replaced most basic fare searches, ticket issuance, and simple changes and refunds. The remaining value lies in disruption handling, connecting-itinerary coordination, services for travelers with special needs, and emotional reassurance. The more automated the system becomes, the more valuable these fallback responsibilities become.
ai_s2_accel: Automated schedule-change notifications and rebooking recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Online ticket purchasing and self-service check-in equipment
AI customer service automatically answers routine inquiries
Systems automatically process ticket changes and refunds
ai_s3_list: Disruption handling: develop solutions on the spot for schedule changes, overbooking, and baggage problems.
Emotional reassurance: when travelers are angry, calm the situation before addressing the transaction.
Connecting-itinerary coordination: arrange connections across carriers and transportation modes.
Services for travelers with special needs: provide hands-on assistance to older adults, children, and people with accessibility needs.
Adaptability: know how to seek approval for exceptions outside standard rules.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates an occupation with a moderately high degree of standardization. AI and self-service equipment have taken over many routine ticketing operations, but counter staff remain indispensable for exception handling and interpersonal service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means that ticket agents who only know how to operate systems are declining in number, while service professionals who can handle complex situations are becoming more valuable. Spend less effort memorizing procedures and more time practicing disruption handling and communication. Once AI completes the easy work, the difficult cases define your role.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For those seeking careers in airline or rail service, education and academic specialization are only entry credentials; service awareness and adaptability are the core capabilities. Participate in social activities during college to practice communication. Do not expect to remain at a service window for an entire career; plan to advance into management or operations.

Make schedule-disruption handling, connecting-itinerary coordination, and services for travelers with special needs your signature capabilities. Proactively learn new ticketing systems and big-data processing tools, then advance toward roles such as shift supervisor, service quality specialist, or operations manager.

People with customer service, sales, or administrative backgrounds generally transition smoothly. Highlight experience handling complaints and high-volume demand on your resume. Enter the field first, then earn credentials such as the civil aviation passenger service agent certification and work toward management.

As self-service expands, counter-service hiring should focus on service-oriented talent who can handle exceptions and reassure travelers. Reposition the role as a travel concierge or service specialist, and provide advancement paths for highly capable employees.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated booking, ticketing, changes, and refunds
Self-service ticket purchase and collection for travelers
Mobile check-in and seat selection for travelers

ai_s7_trends: As online and paperless services continue to expand, conventional ticket counters will keep shrinking and counter roles will transition toward comprehensive service.
Demand for schedule disruption and exception handling will rise, making service-oriented ticketing professionals who can manage complex rebooking and connecting itineraries increasingly scarce.
As omnichannel operations and data-driven service become widespread, ticketing staff will evolve into hybrid travel concierge and operations support roles.

body: Reservation and transportation ticket agents and travel clerks provide travelers with booking, ticket issuance, changes, refunds, itinerary searches, and inquiry services. They handle special needs and exceptional situations to keep transportation services operating smoothly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can find the optimal schedule and issue a ticket in one second, but when a flight is canceled, dozens of stranded travelers need more than a link. They need someone who can make decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一秒查出最优班次、自动出好票，但航班取消时，几十个回不了家的人需要的不是一个链接，是一个能拿主意的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运输票务旅行文员在岗约 13.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.56 万人，净增约 0.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让整个岗位消失，但会吃掉大量标准操作。在线值机、自助售票、AI 客服已经替代了大部分「查票、出票、简单退改」。留下来的价值在异常处置、联程协调、特殊旅客服务和情绪安抚——系统越自动化，这些「兜底」的活越值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 智能排班与旅客流量预测
航变自动通知与改签推荐
全渠道订单统一管理平台
ai_s2_auto: 在线购票与自助值机设备
AI 客服自动解答常规问询
ai_s3_list: 异常处置：航变、超售、行李问题，当场拿方案。
情绪安抚：旅客火大时，先稳住场面再谈业务。
联程协调：跨航司、跨交通方式的衔接安排。
特殊旅客服务：老人、儿童、无障碍需求要跑前跑后。
灵活应变：规则之外的特例，知道怎么向上争取。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这是个「规则化程度中等偏高」的岗位：大量标准票务操作已经被 AI 和自助设备接管，但柜台的异常处理和人际服务依然是不可替代的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着「只会操作系统的票务员」在减少，但「会处理复杂情况的服务者」在增值。别把精力花在背流程上，多练异常处置和沟通——AI 把简单活做完，剩下难办的才是你的位置。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进航空服务、铁路服务方向，学历和专业只是敲门砖，服务意识和应变能力才是核心。大学期间多参加社会实践，练沟通；别指望「窗口坐一辈子」，要往管理或运营方向规划。
把航变处置、联程协调和特殊旅客服务练成招牌能力。主动学新票务系统和大数据处理工具，往值班主管、服务质量或运营管理方向升级。
有客服、销售或行政背景的转行较顺。投简历时突出「处理过投诉、应对过高并发」的经历；先入行再考证（如民航客运员），往管理岗走。
自助化之后，柜台招聘应转向「会处理异常、懂安抚旅客」的服务型人才。建议把岗位向「出行管家/服务专员」重新定位，给能力强的员工留晋升通道。

ai_s7_trends: 在线化与无纸化持续推进，标准票务柜台继续收缩，窗口岗位向综合服务转型。
航变与异常处置的需求上升，会复杂改签、懂联程协调的服务型票务人才更稀缺。
全渠道运营与数据化服务普及，票务人员向「出行管家 + 运营支撑」复合角色演进。

body: 运输与票务旅行文员为旅客提供订票、出票、改签、退票、行程查询与问询服务，处理特殊需求与异常情况，保障运输服务的正常进行。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AutoML can run a dozen models automatically, but statisticians still decide whether to use an experiment or observational study, which confounders to control, and whether conclusions can be generalized.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 32,200 statisticians were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 34,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 2,700 jobs, with about 2,000 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $103,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace statisticians, but it will accelerate basic modeling. AutoML, drag-and-drop analysis, and automated reports speed up descriptive statistics and standard model fitting, shifting statisticians from running models toward experimental design, methodological judgment, causal interpretation, and business alignment. Analysts who only run template scripts will face pressure, while professionals who choose methods and explain conclusions will become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated model selection and tuning with AutoML
ai_s3_list: Experimental design: People determine sampling and controls.
Methodological judgment: People choose the model.
Causal interpretation: People distinguish correlation from causation.
Business alignment: People define metric standards.
Conclusion review: People reject findings that fail scrutiny.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range for analytical work. Systems accelerate basic modeling, but people still design methods and interpret results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces the tasks of running templates and producing standard tables, not jobs centered on choosing methods and explaining causality. People skilled in experimental design and business communication will become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only follow scripts are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in mathematics or statistics and practice programming and real-world data analysis while in school. Pure number-crunching is shrinking in the AI era, so develop method design and interpretation skills early.
Advance from running models to designing approaches and explaining conclusions. Learn AutoML without relying on it exclusively and aim to become the methodological lead.
Highlight real projects and methodological experience, specifying the types of data you have worked with. Employers value rigor and clear explanations.
Do not hire based only on tool proficiency. Assess whether candidates can select appropriate methods. Professionals who can explain causality merit higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AutoML raises productivity and reduces entry-level roles.
Data-driven practices are spreading, increasing demand.
People who choose methods and explain conclusions are in greater demand.

body: Statisticians design data collection and experimental plans, use statistical models and methods to clean and analyze data, test hypotheses, and interpret results, providing quantitative decision support for research, business, and public policy.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AutoML can run a dozen models automatically, but statisticians still decide whether to use an experiment or observational study, which confounders to control, and whether conclusions can be generalized.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AutoML 能自动跑完一打模型，但该用实验还是观测、哪个混杂要控、结论能不能外推，还是统计师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年统计师在岗约 3.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.49 万人，净增约 0.27 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代统计师，但会加速基础建模。AutoML、拖拽式分析和自动报告把描述统计与标准拟合提速，统计师从「跑模型」挪向「实验设计、方法判断、因果解释、业务对齐」。真正被挤掉的是只跑模板脚本的分析员，能定方法讲结论的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实验设计：怎么抽、怎么控靠人。
方法判断：用哪种模型靠人。
因果解释：相关还是因果靠人。
业务对齐：指标口径靠人。
结论把关：经不起检验的否掉靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的分析区——基础建模被系统加速，但方法设计与解释还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑模板、出标准表」的动作，不是「定方法、解释因果」的岗位。有实验设计与业务沟通能力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照脚本跑的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学与统计本科打底，在校多练编程和真实数据。AI 时代纯跑数在缩，早点练方法设计和解释。
从「跑模型」升级成「定方案 + 讲结论」，学 AutoML 但别只靠它，争取当方法负责人。
突出真实项目和方法经验，写清跟过哪些类型数据。雇主看重严谨和讲得清。
选人别只看工具熟，要看会不会定方法。能解释因果的，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: AutoML 提效，基础岗缩。
数据驱动渗透，需求增。
会定方法与讲结论的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: QR codes can take orders, but servers still decide which dishes pair well, how to respond to a guest's mood, and how to smooth over unexpected situations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,329,700 waiters and waitresses were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 2,313,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 16,200 jobs, with approximately 456,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $33,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will reduce routine processes. QR-code ordering and self-service checkout accelerate standard steps, shifting people from carrying dishes and taking orders to welcoming guests, making recommendations, maintaining relationships, and managing the dining experience. Workers who only carry dishes and take orders will be squeezed out, while those who care for guests and make strong recommendations will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Hospitality: people provide thoughtful care.
Dish recommendations: people understand tastes.
Complaint resolution: people respond to emotions.
Relationship maintenance: people cultivate repeat business.
On-the-spot adaptability: people smooth over awkward situations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate ordering and checkout, but people still handle hospitality and recommendations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Carrying dishes and taking orders are being replaced, not roles that care for guests. People who provide attentive service and make recommendations become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build communication and recommendation skills. Pure order taking is shrinking, so develop experience management abilities early.
Advance from carrying dishes to recommendations, relationships, and table turnover, then seek a head server role.
Highlight patience in service and examples of performing under pressure. Restaurants value consistency and speed.
Do not hire based only on physical stamina. Assess whether candidates can care for guests and make recommendations. Core employees who can manage a section are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: As QR-code ordering becomes widespread, food-running roles shrink.
Experience management receives greater emphasis.
People who can make recommendations are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 扫码能点单，但哪道菜配得妙、客人心情怎么接、突发怎么圆，还是服务员的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年服务员在岗约 232.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 231.35 万人，岗位净减约 1.62 万个，年均产生约 45.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.38 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩标准流程。扫码点单与自助结账把常规环节提速，人从「传菜点单」挪向「接待、推荐、关系维护、体验经营」。真正被挤掉的是只做传菜点单的，会照顾、能推荐的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 接待照顾：体面靠人。
菜品推荐：口味靠人懂。
投诉化解：情绪靠人接。
关系维护：回头靠人养。
临场应变：圆场靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——点单结账被系统加速，但接待与推荐还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「传菜点单」动作，不是「照顾客人」的岗位。会照顾、能推荐的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 多练沟通与推荐，纯点单在缩，早点练体验经营。
从「传菜」升级成「推荐 + 关系 + 翻台」，争取领班。
突出服务耐心和抗压案例，餐厅看重稳和快。
选人别只看体力，要看会不会照顾和推荐，能带区的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 扫码点单普及，传菜缩。
体验经营更被看重。
会推荐的人更抢手。
